biophysical_burden.boundary: Global rerouting burden; no route-level delay is invented.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Selected global freight-index pressure, not a consumer-price or economy-wide loss estimate.

excluded_from_scoring: port-call count treated as dwell time

transformations.formula: Divide source-reported ton-mile growth by maritime-trade volume growth while retaining both values.
Normalize the source-reported SCFI departure from its pre-pandemic average.
Use the source-reported seaborne share of world trade volume.

receipts.uncertainty: Freight indices cover selected routes and prices; port calls are activity rather than congestion duration; rerouting attribution, vessel capacity, cargo mix, blank sailings, contracts, fuel, insurance and reporting timing affect comparisons.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNCTAD quantifies global rerouting ton-mile burden, freight-rate pressure, multi-year persistence and maritime trade exposure.
higher_priority_failures: No complete 20-year globally comparable route-delay series supports historical-percentile current scoring.
Port-call activity is not converted into delay, so the assessment remains accumulated impact.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Observed mangrove subset only; seagrass and salt-marsh stocks are not added.

excluded_from_scoring: future restoration targets and restorable area
raw OBIS occurrence counts as habitat-area evidence

transformations.formula: Use the quantified mangrove carbon-stock reduction as a non-additive observed subset of blue-carbon habitat loss.
Normalize the midpoint of the source damage range while retaining both bounds.
Divide countries with mangroves by the source denominator.

receipts.uncertainty: Historical baselines, habitat definitions, remote-sensing classification, unmapped small patches, natural gains and losses, carbon-stock methods, service valuation and proximity-based population exposure affect estimates. Proximity does not establish individual dependence.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNEP quantifies observed mangrove-area and carbon-stock loss, associated annual damage, persistence and global country extent as a bounded blue-carbon subset.
higher_priority_failures: No current global annual harmonized inventory covers mangroves, seagrasses and salt marshes together.
Habitat areas and carbon stocks are not added across incompatible assessments.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Seagrass nursery habitat is a quantified subset; the score does not claim equivalent loss in every estuary.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Nursery dependence is exposed fisheries scope, not realized catch loss.

excluded_from_scoring: future restoration targets and restorable area
raw OBIS occurrence counts as habitat-area evidence

transformations.formula: Use observed seagrass habitat loss as a bounded subset of estuarine and coastal nursery loss.
Normalize the source-reported share of major fisheries supported by seagrass nurseries without relabeling it as realized loss.
Divide countries with seagrass by the source denominator.

receipts.uncertainty: Historical baselines, habitat definitions, remote-sensing classification, unmapped small patches, natural gains and losses, carbon-stock methods, service valuation and proximity-based population exposure affect estimates. Proximity does not establish individual dependence.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNEP quantifies historical seagrass nursery-habitat loss, fisheries dependence, multi-decade persistence and country extent.
higher_priority_failures: No current harmonized global annual estuary recruitment panel supplies magnitude plus threshold or momentum.
The evidence is explicitly a seagrass nursery subset rather than a total-estuary estimate.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Global monitored coastal and shelf inventory lower bound; site count is not converted to area.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Exposed fisheries-system dependence, not realized attributable loss.

extent.geographic_scope: Worldwide nutrient losses to air, soil, rivers, lakes, marine and coastal systems; coastal eutrophication and dead-zone inventories are global lower bounds

excluded_from_scoring: dead-zone count converted to area or volume
fisheries dependence treated as realized loss
reactive-nitrogen pathways added across overlapping budgets

transformations.formula: Normalize the monitored coastal and shelf hypoxia inventory without converting sites to area.
Normalize nearshore fisheries dependence without treating it as realized loss.
Use the source-declared worldwide coastal-system scope.

receipts.uncertainty: Reactive-nitrogen budgets combine air, soil, freshwater and marine pathways. The annual resource-cost estimate is global nitrogen loss, not an allocated water-pollution damage value. Coastal-system inventories depend on monitoring and definitions and therefore are lower bounds. Fisheries dependence is economic-system exposure, not realized attributable loss.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNEP quantifies a worldwide coastal and shelf low-oxygen inventory, fisheries-system exposure, multi-decade accumulation and global scope.
higher_priority_failures: The operational NOAA survey is regional and cannot provide a current global shelf aggregation.
Monitoring-dependent site inventories do not form a complete 20-year annual global observation panel.
